title: Joseph and the King's Dreams
reflectionQuestion: God gave Joseph wisdom, and Joseph used it to help a whole land of people. What is a wise and helpful thing you could do?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Joseph, mature tier). The WISDOM/helping story -- a deliberately different Joseph lane (Adam): coat=beloved child (1844), reunion=forgiveness (1819), this=dreams->wisdom, saving Egypt->helping others. Keeps the BROTHERS out: the painful backstory is compressed to 'it had not been an easy road... but God had been with him' (no pit/sale/betrayal -- consistent with 1844 softening). The famine is gentle ('hard years when food is scarce'), framed as something Joseph's wisdom prepares for. God is the source of the wisdom (Joseph: 'I cannot do it on my own, but God can'). Indelible image = Joseph before Pharaoh reading the dreams / the full barns saving people. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH (reassuring father; continuity with 1844 coat, the lead-up to his rise).
